files.README.md:
Open-source framework for Claude Code sessions

Persistent memory • Unified retrieval • Adaptive learning • Spec-driven orchestration • Auto-update

Install • Quick Start • Features • Update • CLI • Uninstall

--- ## What is Stratus? **Stratus** is an open-source framework that extends Claude Code with: - **Persistent memory** — Claude remembers across sessions via SQLite + FTS5 - **Intelligent retrieval** — code via Vexor, governance docs via built-in index - **Adaptive learning** — automatically proposes rules, ADRs, templates, and skills - **Spec-driven orchestration** — isolated worktrees, reviewer verdict loops, agent coordination - **Auto-update** — one-command updates from GitHub releases with version checking Stratus is **not** a separate agent runtime. It integrates directly into Claude Code via: - **Hooks** — event handlers for lifecycle events - **MCP Server** — tools available to agents - **HTTP API** — local server with dashboard --- ## Why Stratus? | Problem | Solution | |---------|----------| | Claude forgets between sessions | SQLite + FTS5 persistent memory | | Chaotic project rules | Automatic generation of rules/ADRs/templates | | Manual context switching | Spec-driven worktree isolation | | Inconsistent code quality | TDD enforcer, lint hooks, reviewer verdicts | | Lost decisions and patterns | Learning pipeline proposes governance artifacts | --- ## Benefits - **Zero vendor lock-in** — everything runs locally, SQLite databases, no cloud services - **Non-intrusive** — hooks are best-effort, never block your workflow - **Modular** — use only what you need (memory, retrieval, learning, orchestration) - **CLI-first** — everything controllable from the terminal - **Claude Code native** — integrates directly into the ecosystem (hooks, MCP, statusline) --- ## What's Included ``` stratus/ ├── bootstrap/ # Project detection, config generation ├── memory/ # Durable event/session store (SQLite + FTS5) ├── retrieval/ # Vexor + governance search ├── learning/ # Pattern detection, scoring, proposals ├── orchestration/ # Spec state machine, worktree lifecycle ├── hooks/ # Claude Code event handlers (13 hooks) ├── mcp_server/ # MCP tool surface for agents ├── server/ # Starlette HTTP API + dashboard ├── self_debug/ # Static analysis + patch generation ├── update/ # Auto-update from GitHub releases └── registry/ # 26 agents (7 core + 19 delivery) ``` **Included hooks:** - `context_monitor` — warns on high token usage - `file_checker` — ruff/eslint/gofmt on Write/Edit - `tdd_enforcer` — alerts on code without tests - `tool_redirect` — suggests `retrieve` over web search - `learning_trigger` — detects git commit/merge, triggers learning - `spec_stop_guard` — blocks exit during verify phase - `session_end` — cleanup at session end - + 6 more --- ## Installation ### Option A: pipx (recommended) ```bash pipx install stratus ``` ### Option B: Installer script ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartinNevlaha/stratus/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option C: From source ```bash git clone https://github.com/MartinNevlaha/stratus.git cd stratus uv sync --dev ``` ### Requirements - Python 3.12+ - Git (for worktree features) - Optional: [Vexor](https://github.com/MartinNevlaha/vexor) for code retrieval --- ## Quick Start ### 1. Initialize your project ```bash cd /path/to/your/git/repo stratus init ``` This creates/updates: - `.ai-framework.json` — main config - `.claude/settings.json` — hooks registration - `.mcp.json` — MCP server - `project-graph.json` — project metadata ### 2. Start the API server ```bash stratus serve ``` Default: `http://127.0.0.1:41777` ### 3. Health check ```bash stratus doctor ``` ### 4. Open dashboard ``` http://127.0.0.1:41777/dashboard ``` --- ## Dashboard UI The Stratus Dashboard provides a real-time monitoring interface with 5 tabs: ### Overview Tab - **Swarm visualization** — animated canvas showing active agents orbiting with category colors - **Phase progress** — current workflow phase with progress bar (spec/bug/delivery) - **Active agents** — list of currently running agents with role indicators - **Learning panel** — sensitivity, candidates count, pending proposals - **Memory panel** — total events and sessions - **Logs panel** — real-time event stream - **Terminal** — interactive terminal with speech-to-text button (mic) ### Retrieve Tab - **Vexor — Code Search** - Index status (available/unavailable, fresh/stale) - Files count, commit SHA, model, last indexed timestamp - Search input with results (expandable cards with metadata) - **Governance DB** - Index stats (files, chunks) - Document type pills: rule, adr, template, skill, agent, architecture, project - Search across rules, ADRs, skills, templates ### Memory Tab - **Memory search** — full-text search across all memory events - **Recent memories** — expandable event cards with: - Title, text preview, timestamp - Type/scope/actor badges, tag pills - Importance bar, full metadata on expand - **Sessions list** — session IDs with project, initial prompt, start time ### Agents Tab - **Agent Registry** — table of all 26 agents with: - Name, model tag (sonnet/opus/haiku) - Layer tag (engineering/process) - Write/read-only badge - Expandable detail: filename, phases, task types, stacks, modes, keywords - **Skills** — chips list with description, agent, context - **Rules** — chips list of `.claude/rules/*.md` files ### Learning Tab - **Pending Proposals** - Proposal cards with title, type tag, confidence bar - Accept/Reject/Ignore action buttons (POST to `/api/learning/decide`) - **Failure Analytics** - Total failures, trend indicator (increasing/stable/decreasing) - Breakdown by category - **Hotspot Files** — files with most failures - **Rule Effectiveness** — table with rule name, score %, verdict (effective/neutral/ineffective) ### Screenshots ![Stratus Dashboard](./ui.png) ### 5. Reconcile existing agents/skills/rules (recommended) In Claude Code: ``` /stratus:sync-stratus ``` This skill scans your environment and produces a conflict report against the Stratus delegation model. --- ## Spec-Driven Development Modes Stratus provides two spec modes based on task complexity: | Command | Phases | Flow | |---------|--------|------| | `/spec` | 4 | Plan → Do → Review → Learn | | `/spec-complex` | 8 | Discovery → Design → Governance → Plan → Accept → Implement → Review → Learn | ### When to Use Which? | Use `/spec` (Simple) | Use `/spec-complex` (Complex) | |----------------------|-------------------------------| | Single file changes | Authentication, authorization | | Bug fixes | Database migrations, schema changes | | Small refactorings | API design, new endpoints | | Clear, well-defined scope | Third-party integrations | | < 3 files affected | Multi-service changes | | No security impact | Infrastructure, CI/CD changes | | No database changes | Unclear or evolving requirements | ### Flow Comparison ``` SIMPLE (4-phase) COMPLEX (8-phase) ───────────────── ───────────────────── Plan ─────────────┐ Discovery ────┐ │ │ Do ───────────────┤ Design ───────┤ │ │ Review ───────────┤ Governance ───┤ (skip if no risk) │ │ Learn ────────────┘ Plan ─────────┤ │ │ Accept ────────┤ (user gate) │ │ Implement ─────┤ │ │ Review ────────┤ │ │ Learn ─────────┘ ``` --- ## CLI Reference ### Basic commands ```bash stratus --version # Version stratus init # Initialize project stratus init --scope global # Global installation stratus init --enable-delivery # With delivery agents stratus doctor # Health check stratus serve # HTTP API server stratus mcp-serve # MCP stdio server stratus statusline # Status line for Claude Code ``` ### Worktree orchestration ```bash stratus worktree detect # Detect existing worktree stratus worktree create # Create worktree stratus worktree diff # Diff vs base branch stratus worktree sync # Squash-merge to main stratus worktree cleanup # Delete worktree + branch stratus worktree status # Worktree status ``` ### Learning pipeline ```bash stratus learning status # Learning engine status stratus learning analyze # Run analysis stratus learning proposals # List proposals stratus learning decide ID accept # Accept proposal stratus learning decide ID reject # Reject proposal stratus learning config # Show config ``` ### Other ```bash stratus analyze # Analyze transcript stratus reindex [--full] # Reindex retrieval stratus retrieval-status # Retrieval backend status stratus hook # Run hook module stratus self-debug # Self-debug analysis stratus update # Check for and apply updates stratus update --check # Check only (don't apply) stratus update --dry-run # Show what would be done stratus update -y # Skip confirmation ``` --- ## Auto-Update Stratus includes a built-in auto-update mechanism that fetches the latest release from GitHub. ### Check for updates ```bash # Check only (no changes made) stratus update --check ``` Output example: ``` Current version: 1.0.0 Latest version: 1.2.0 Update available! Release notes: https://github.com/MartinNevlaha/Stratus/releases/tag/v1.2.0 ## Features - New feature A - Improved performance ... ``` ### Apply updates ```bash # Interactive update (prompts for confirmation) stratus update # Skip confirmation prompt stratus update -y # Preview what would be done (no changes) stratus update --dry-run ``` ### Update flow ``` 1. Check cached result (24h TTL) └── If fresh cache exists → use cached data └── If stale/no cache → fetch from GitHub 2. Compare versions (semantic versioning) └── Current >= Latest → "Already up to date" └── Current < Latest → proceed 3. Detect installation method ├── pipx → pipx upgrade stratus ├── venv → ~/.local/share/stratus/venv/bin/pip install --upgrade ... ├── pypi → pip install --upgrade stratus └── source → "Cannot update (use git pull)" 4. Prompt for confirmation (unless -y) └── "Run 'pipx upgrade stratus'? [y/N]" 5. Execute update command └── Timeout: 120 seconds ``` ### Installation method detection | Method | Detection | Update Command | |--------|-----------|----------------| | **pipx** | `pipx list` contains "stratus" | `pipx upgrade stratus` | | **venv** | Binary path contains `~/.local/share/stratus/venv` | `venv/bin/pip install --upgrade git+...` | | **PyPI** | Binary in `/usr/local/` or `/usr/bin/` | `pip install --upgrade stratus` | | **source** | Binary in `.venv` or `site-packages` | Manual: `git pull` | ### Update channels | Channel | Description | |---------|-------------| | `stable` | Only stable releases (default) | | `beta` | Includes pre-release versions | Configure in `.ai-framework.json`: ```json { "update": { "channel": "beta" } } ``` Or via environment: ```bash export AI_FRAMEWORK_UPDATE_CHANNEL=beta ``` ### Cache location Update check results are cached to avoid repeated API calls: ``` ~/.ai-framework/data/update-check.json ``` Cache is valid for 24 hours (configurable via `check_interval_hours`). ### Disable updates ```bash # Via environment export AI_FRAMEWORK_UPDATE_ENABLED=false # Via config file # .ai-framework.json { "update": { "enabled": false } } ``` ### Troubleshooting | Issue | Solution | |-------|----------| | "Cannot update: installed from source" | Run `git pull` in the stratus repository | | "Update timed out" | Check network connection, try again | | "Network error" (no cache) | Check internet connection | | Version not updating after update | Restart terminal or rehash shell (`hash -r`) | --- ## Init Flags | Flag | Description | |------|-------------| | `--dry-run` | Show actions without writing | | `--force` | Overwrite existing `.ai-framework.json` | | `--scope local\|global` | Project vs global installation | | `--skip-hooks` | Don't register hooks | | `--skip-mcp` | Don't register MCP server | | `--skip-retrieval` | Skip retrieval setup | | `--skip-agents` | Skip runtime agents | | `--enable-delivery` | Install delivery agent set | --- ## Claude Code Plugin ```bash claude --plugin-dir ./plugin ``` Available commands: | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/stratus:spec` | Simple spec (4-phase): Plan → Do → Review → Learn | | `/stratus:spec-complex` | Complex spec (8-phase): Discovery → Design → Governance → ... | | `/stratus:init` | Initialize project | | `/stratus:doctor` | Health check | | `/stratus:status` | Show status | | `/stratus:analyze` | Analyze transcript | | `/stratus:reindex` | Reindex retrieval | | `/stratus:proposals` | List learning proposals | | `/stratus:decide` | Decide on proposal | | `/stratus:worktree` | Worktree operations | --- ## Configuration ### Environment variables | Variable | Default | Description | |----------|---------|-------------| | `AI_FRAMEWORK_DATA_DIR` | `~/.ai-framework/data` | Data directory | | `AI_FRAMEWORK_PORT` | `41777` | API port | | `CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID` | `default` | Session ID | ### Config file `.ai-framework.json` — main project config ```json { "learning": { "global_enabled": true, "sensitivity": "moderate" }, "self_debug": { "enabled": false }, "retrieval": { "vexor_enabled": true }, "update": { "enabled": true, "channel": "stable", "check_interval_hours": 24 } } ``` ### Update configuration | Field | Default | Description | |-------|---------|-------------| | `enabled` | `true` | Enable auto-update checking | | `channel` | `stable` | Update channel (`stable` or `beta`) | | `check_interval_hours` | `24` | Hours between update checks | Environment overrides: - `AI_FRAMEWORK_UPDATE_ENABLED` — enable/disable updates - `AI_FRAMEWORK_UPDATE_CHANNEL` — set channel - `AI_FRAMEWORK_UPDATE_CHECK_INTERVAL_HOURS` — check frequency --- ## Uninstall ```bash # Uninstall without project cleanup ./scripts/uninstall.sh # Uninstall with project cleanup ./scripts/uninstall.sh --project # If installed via pipx pipx uninstall stratus ``` --- ## Development ```bash # Tests uv run pytest -q uv run pytest --cov=stratus --cov-fail-under=80 # Lint uv run ruff check src/ tests/ uv run basedpyright src/ ``` --- ## Docker ```bash docker build -t stratus . docker run -p 41777:41777 -v ~/.ai-framework:/root/.ai-framework stratus ``` --- ## Architecture (High Level) ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Claude Code │ │ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │ │ │ Hooks │ │ MCP │ │ Statusline│ │ Plugin │ │ │ └────┬─────┘ └────┬─────┘ └────┬─────┘ └────┬─────┘ │ └───────┼─────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────┼──────────┘ │ │ │ │ └─────────────┴──────┬──────┴─────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ HTTP API (port 41777) │ │ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │ │ │ Memory │ │ Retrieval│ │ Learning │ │Orchestr. │ │ │ └────┬─────┘ └────┬─────┘ └────┬─────┘ └────┬─────┘ │ └───────┼─────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────┼──────────┘ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ SQLite Storage │ │ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │ │ │ Memory │ │ Embed │ │ Learning │ │Governance│ │ │ │ DB │ │ Cache │ │ DB │ │ Store │ │ │ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` --- ## Repository Layout ``` src/stratus/ # Framework source tests/ # Test suite (100+ test files) scripts/ # Install/uninstall helpers docs/ # Architecture & design docs ``` --- ## License Apache License 2.0 — see `LICENSE` --- ## Links - **Repository:** https://github.com/MartinNevlaha/stratus - **Issues:** https://github.com/MartinNevlaha/stratus/issues - **PyPI:** https://pypi.org/project/stratus/
